numbered_ideas.title: Make the phones indispensable
numbered_ideas.refinement: Private contextual offers and disclose-to-party intent; no hidden payloads in public display.

numbered_ideas.title: Turn the Tempo Engine into a signature feature
numbered_ideas.refinement: Typed accessible profiles; urgency cannot remove legal actions or invent a timer.

numbered_ideas.title: Predictive media generation
numbered_ideas.refinement: Bounded heuristic forecasts; ready hits fast, misses have nonblocking permitted fallback, no instant guarantee.

numbered_ideas.title: Make NPCs actual agents
numbered_ideas.refinement: Existing truth/belief/goals/secrets/relationship/obligation models, with NPC performed by validated expression.

numbered_ideas.title: Rumors and social propagation
numbered_ideas.refinement: Witness/source/contact-path provenance, deterministic bounded rumor fanout/TTL and accepted logical time.

numbered_ideas.title: Narrative convergence
numbered_ideas.refinement: Plausible bounded convergence must preserve choice, truth, NPC motivation and ignored/failed arcs.

numbered_ideas.title: "Previously on DungeonFlux"
numbered_ideas.refinement: Audience-permitted committed history; optional quoted video plus still/narration fallback and consented export.

numbered_ideas.title: End-of-session trailer
numbered_ideas.refinement: Explicit speculative label, known-thread-only imagery, no secrets/future fact/forced scene.

numbered_ideas.title: Player spotlight director
numbered_ideas.refinement: Opt-in observed interaction windows and consented credible hooks; no boredom inference or forced disclosure.

numbered_ideas.title: Cinematic reactions to critical events
numbered_ideas.refinement: Committed source-valid critical event eligibility; skippable cue/fallback, no outcome retcon or unauthorized game freeze.

numbered_ideas.title: Generate bespoke legendary items
numbered_ideas.refinement: Personalized origin/media on legal template; new mechanics only explicitly disclosed/approved custom RulesetId/handler.

numbered_ideas.title: Dynamic boss design
numbered_ideas.refinement: Approved source-compatible boss phases/objectives/hazards reflect committed history; no invented HP/effect/physics.

numbered_ideas.title: Persistent world simulation
numbered_ideas.refinement: Schedules/factions/resources advance under accepted campaign time; paused world does not run off wall time.

numbered_ideas.title: Live environmental transformation
numbered_ideas.refinement: Stable scene identity/version and validated world/geometry consequences with late-asset/stale-revisit safety.

numbered_ideas.title: The "anything" interaction layer
numbered_ideas.refinement: Bounded legal compound plans, step revalidation/partial outcomes; unsupported wine/physics uses NeedsRuling, never unrestricted simulation.
